plans.note: Art. 13: 13.1 direct damages only (p0198), 13.2 mutual no-consequential (p0205), 13.4 cap on M&I total liability tied to payments made (p0207) - check cap size, mutuality, carve-outs. ACH-specific liability limit at p0117.
14.2 A. By Customer (p0219), B. By M&I (p0220); 14.3 procedures (p0221, p0223). Check IP-infringement coverage, breadth of our indemnity, interaction with 13.4 cap. Mutual ACH indemnity p0114.
No non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer surfaced; hits are severability/confidentiality/entire-agreement only. Confirm in Sec 10 and 21.11 before concluding absent.

Art. 3 Appointment (p0056-p0058) may create de facto exclusivity; 21.11 Future Acquisitions (p0281, p0282) appears to require acquired institutions to be processed by M&I - key exclusivity-type restriction. Other 'exclusive' hits unrelated.
No most-favoured-nation, best-pricing or no-less-favourable language found across repeated searches. MFN in our favour is optional, so no redline required.
22.14 Solicitation (p0302): mutual bar on soliciting the other party's employees during the Term. Check duration/tail and general-advertising carve-out.

11.1 For Convenience (p0187): one year notice plus redacted Termination for Convenience Fee; 11.2 For Cause fee (p0189); no fee on M&I default (p0190); 13.5 LD acknowledgement (p0208); disaster termination without penalty (p0263); default remedies (p0196); M&I right to modify/terminate Services (p0181).
2.1 Initial Term (p0054) and 2.2 Extensions (p0055) with 18-month notice mechanic; assess non-renewal window and extension pricing.

22.1 Wisconsin law (p0286); 22.2 exclusive venue Milwaukee County / Federal District (p0287); attorneys' fees reference to arbitration (p0299). Also review Art. 15 Dispute Resolution for any arbitration overlay.

22.4 Assignment (p0289): no assignment by either party by operation of law or otherwise - check affiliate/successor carve-out for us. Change in Control definition (p0028); 21.11.B (p0284); locate Sec 11.3 termination following Customer change in control in sec-11/sec-p0191.

10.4 Developed Software (p0185): M&I owns work we pay for - primary deviation candidate. 17.1 Customer Data ownership in our favour (p0243), confidentiality scope (p0245), safeguards (p0250), source-code use limits (p0313).

Source-code licence: non-exclusive, non-transferable, Term-limited, internal use, no sublicense (p0310, p0313); escrow context (p0306). Check affiliate/contractor scope and revocability. Also RDS/EFT licence limits (p0120, p0125).

Audit-related provisions run in our favour: regulatory examination access (p0274, p0276), M&I third-party data-centre review (p0277), examination of Confidential Information (p0243), M&I financial statements (p0300). No vendor audit of Customer usage located - verify before concluding; do not flag clauses benefiting us.

13.5 Liquidated Damages (p0208) validating Termination for Convenience/Cause Fees payable by Customer; fee mechanics p0187/p0189; Estimated Remaining Value definition p0039. Coordinate with T4C to avoid double-flagging the same fee.

16.1 M&I warranties (p0230 et seq) with capitalised Disclaimer of Warranties (p0236) - check whether disclaimer guts the performance warranty. Art. 9 Performance Standards (p0155, p0156, p0158), Customer-fault excuse (p0176), warranties extend to third-party Initial Services (p0058); look for credits/re-performance remedy.

14.1 Insurance (p0210): CGL (p0212), Fidelity/employee dishonesty (p0214), Workers' Comp and Employer's Liability (p0215), All Risk Property (p0216). Check limits, E&O/cyber and certificate/cancellation-notice duties.

Minimum monthly fee / Monthly Base Fee based on resource volume (p0130), payable in advance (p0149), feeding Estimated Remaining Value termination fee (p0039); bundling acknowledgement (p0183); Schedule 6.2 (p0086). Assess as take-or-pay with exit only via paid termination fee.

11.4 Termination Assistance (p0192): assistance on any termination but at Customer's expense at M&I then-current rates, six-month continuation on 100 days' notice. No express Customer Data return-in-usable-format obligation surfaced; check p0243/p0250 for data custody.
